_note: The Premium Shop's catalog (Step 59): optional real-money products, no ads, nothing required. PROPOSED configuration until the platform storefront (Google Play) has the products and the owner approves them. The game never shows `proposed_price`: a price on screen comes from the storefront, and with no storefront connected the shop says 'Coming soon' and sells nothing. `steps` are what each purchase would make the island's speed (x2 each, five at most); nothing in the simulation reads them yet.
_ads_note: Step 75: the game shows no ads -- no ad SDK, no ad ID, nothing loaded from an ad network. `ads_shown` says so to the model; a product with `requires_ads` is never offered while it is false (selling the removal of something absent would mislead).

products._note: Step 75, a catalog entry only: a one-time, non-consumable entitlement for a possible future version that shows ads. Never sold before the game has ads and billing is a validated step; its SKU and price are chosen with the owner then, so there is neither here. See design/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md (Remove Ads).
